ev.q: Adherence to all recommended PPE ranged from 4% in primary and urgent care settings to 48% in community health and STI clinics.
Only 23% of exposed HCP wore all recommended PPE.
118 (38%) reported wearing an N95 respirator while treating or interacting with monkeypox patients.
N95 respirator use by HCP varied among health care settings
CDPHE interviewed patients with monkeypox and reviewed medical records to ascertain whether lesions were present during health care exposures.

methods_quotes.q: These data were summarized and stratified by facility type and job title.
Analyses were completed using R statistical software (version 2021.09.2; The R Foundation).
HCP who had cared for out-of-state patients or for patients who were lost to follow-up were excluded from the analysis.
